EmailTemplate.subject: Your Qantas spa appointment request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_First_Host_First_Name__c},
Thank you for your enquiry regarding a spa appointment in the Qantas First Lounge.
Unfortunately, we’re unable to confirm an appointment for you on this occasion as your departure is outside of the spa’s operating hours.
We do apologise for the inconvenience, however trust you’ll enjoy the Qantas Lounge experience.
Warm regards, {!User.FirstName} Customer Relationship Specialist Qantas {!IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_SSU_Formula__c = TRUE, "Special","VIP")} Service Team {!IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_SSU_Formula__c = TRUE, "World Wide +61 (2) 6250 8204", IF(QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Frequent_Flyer_Tier_Formula__c = "Chairmans Lounge" || QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Frequent_Flyer_Tier_Formula__c = "Platinum One" || QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Frequent_Flyer_Tier_Formula__c = "Chairmans Lounge Platinum One" || QCC_First_Host__c.QCC_Tier_Effective_Tier_Formula__c ="FFLP" ,"World Wide +61 1300 752 801","vipserviceteam@qantas.com.au"))}
